t: The Rotor Blade is the last component of your $(l:bigreactors:turbine/rotor)Rotor$(/l), but it's the one that will make it spin.$(br2)A Rotor Blade can only be placed perpendicularly to a $(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-rotorshaft)Rotor Shaft$(/l) block or beside an already placed Blade, moving away from the shaft block.
扇叶是你的$(l:bigreactors:turbine/rotor)转子$(/l)的最后一个组成部分，但也正是它让转子旋转起来。$(br2)扇叶只能垂直于某个$(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-rotorshaft)转子轴$(/l)方块放置，或放在已放置扇叶的旁边，并沿着远离轴方块的方向延伸。
$(l)Mandatory:$() yes$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() inside the Turbine, connected to another Blade or a Rotor Shaft block$(br)$(l)Variants:$() all$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
$(l)必需：$()是$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()涡轮机内部，与另一片扇叶或转子轴方块相连$(br)$(l)变种：$()全部$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()否
